intro.title: Hart County Probate Court
intro.description: Serving Hart County residents with estate, guardianship, licensing, records, and other matters within the jurisdiction of Probate Court.

contact.street_address:
Hart County Courthouse Annex
185 West Franklin Street

overview: The Hart County Probate Court assists with settling estates and guardianships, handles traffic, gaming, and fishing cases, and records and maintains public records such as vital records and marriage certificates.
services: Administers oaths of elected and appointed officials
Presides over estate and traffic court
